name: SPHERE Black Speaker
description: SPHERE pairs a black rectangular cabinet with a sculptural circular front and prominent top-mounted controls.
fullDescription: SPHERE creates its visual identity through the relationship between a simple outer cabinet and a more expressive front surface. Circular recesses and a sculpted central form introduce depth, while the top-mounted physical controls remain clearly visible. The dark finish keeps the emphasis on shape and shadow. Within the ECHO speaker collection, SPHERE offers a squarer, more geometric counterpart to MONO's tall silhouette.
